artworks.title: Self-Portrait (Collapse by the Lamp/Kolaps przy lampie)
artworks.medium: gelatin silver print
artworks.creditLine: Foto Fund and Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body, focusing on his face and hands as he leans forward on a table. His face is partially shaded, showing a serious expression with deep-set eyes and a slightly furrowed brow. He has short, dark hair and is dressed in a dark suit with a white shirt visible at the cuffs and collar. An ornate lit oil lamp with a glass body and metal base is next to him on the table. The background is dark, emphasizing the illuminated areas.

artworks.title: Belle-Croix
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gail and Benjamin Jacobs for the Millennium Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a view from a low perspective of a tranquil body of water surrounded by trees. The horizon is obscured by dense foliage, with tree tops forming a natural canopy. Trees are detailed with their trunks and branches extending into the water. The monochromatic color palette gives a serene quality, with the contrast between light and shadows creating depth. The scene is calm and contemplative, with reflections in the water mirroring the branches above.

artworks.title: A Naked Man, Seated, with His Hands Tied
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in greenish brown and black on laid paper, mounted on old album sheet
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Judith Keenan
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of two figures in various poses. One figure, an older man with long hair and a beard, is seated with his torso twisted towards the viewer, legs crossed, and arms extended. Another figure, a younger man with short hair, is positioned on the older man's left, leaning towards him with his arm around his shoulder. Both figures appear nude, emphasizing their muscular physiques. The background is highly detailed with textured cross-hatching and shading, adding depth to the engraving. An inscription is visible in the center bottom of the artwork.

artworks.title: Pan IV (Arcadia)
artworks.medium: color lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Judith Keenan
artworks.description: Three figures are depicted in a natural setting. The central figure is draped in yellow, leaning against a tree. The second figure is covered in red, resting on one elbow. The third figure, beside the tree, holds a flute. The background shows a colorful landscape with a blue and orange sky, green terrain, and lush trees.

artworks.title: Elegant Lady Seated in a Chair
artworks.medium: red chalk with white heightening on blue wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ellwanger/Mescha Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a seated woman in a three-quarters back view, sitting upright on a wooden chair. The woman has refined features with a hat adorned with feathers or floral elements and a veil. She wears a long gown with voluminous sleeves, typical of late 19th or early 20th-century fashion, and holds an umbrella or parasol in her right hand. The background is plain, emphasizing the woman's appearance and posture.

artworks.title: Jewelry Design with a Lion's Head
artworks.medium: engraving in laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an emblem with intricate detailing. The top half of the image shows a shield-like design with floral patterns in a symmetrical arrangement, bordered by tendrils, and crowned by a stylized lion or beast's head. Below the central motif, there are two figures in elaborate historical costumes. The figure on the left wears a cap with a hanging tassel and distinctive spectacles, holding an open book. The figure on the right wears a feathered hat, looking back at the other figure and holding an object that resembles an abacus or a ladder. The year 1619 is inscribed near the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Design for a Beetle-Shaped Pendant
artworks.medium: engraving in laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large ornamental beetle with intricate patterns on its back. It is surrounded by smaller beetles and human figures. The smaller beetles are simpler in design. Two figures are depicted in the bottom part of the drawing - one under a tree wearing a feathered hat, and another pair engaged in conversation. The drawing is in black and white, emphasizing fine detail reminiscent of early European etchings.

artworks.title: Design for a Turtle-Shaped Pendant
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing with an ornate oval crest at the center featuring intricate floral designs. Below the crest, there is a scene of two figures in a physical struggle, with one figure restraining the other. Another figure stands to the left gesturing towards the entanglement, with a small dog between them. Sparse grass patches and a small object resembling a hat are depicted on the ground. Ornamental, linear motifs frame the drawing, and the date "1618" is inscribed beneath the scene.

artworks.title: Printmaker (Le Graveur)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ellwanger/Mescha Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated at a table, with a side view revealing the upper half of their body as they lean forward slightly. The person is positioned in front of a bright drawing board or illuminated surface. Their facial features are not clearly visible, but they have shoulder-length hair and are wearing a dark jacket. Above them hangs a large lamp, casting a strong light on the board below. The background is mostly dark, with a few details of furniture and an easel faintly visible.

artworks.title: An Allegory of Pride
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 9.9 x 7.5 cm (3 7/8 x 2 15/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image features a seated woman with long hair, wearing an elaborate dress and a flower and leaf crown. She holds a mirror in her right hand and her left hand rests on her lap. She wears a necklace with a pendant and sits on a creature with a coiled shell and a dragon-like head. The background has a patterned cross-hatching texture.

artworks.title: Scherzo with Antique Figures
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over red chalk on laid paper pasted down on the remains of the artist's original mount
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures gathered in a dynamic composition. The drawing appears to be executed in ink or similar medium, using expressive and fluid strokes to create the forms of several figures. One of the figures has wings, and the other figures are engaged in an interaction. There are suggestions of drapery and flowing garments, contributing to the sense of movement and drama. The background features swirling lines and washes, adding depth and atmosphere to the scene. The drawing has a sense of energy and immediacy.

artworks.title: Venus, Cupid, and Mars
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with touches of oiled black chalk on tan laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch with a seated woman and child, alongside a separate figure of a man. The woman is reclining on her side, looking down at the child she is holding. The child faces her with short curly hair. The woman appears minimally clothed, with drapery lines indicating clothing around her lower body. On the right side of the image, there is a sketch of a bearded man wearing a helmet and possibly armor, with outlines suggesting curly hair or a plume on the helmet. The background is the brown-toned paper.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray-brown wash on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of four figures surrounding a seated woman. The woman is on the left, looking upwards, with gentle facial features and long hair under a draped head covering. To her right, a man reclines, holding a child with shoulder-length hair. The child is resting in the man's arms, with only the head and upper body visible. On the far left, a young standing figure leans in. The figures are wearing flowing robes, and there is a simplistic hat in the foreground. The background depicts a minimalist mountainous or rocky landscape.

artworks.title: The Conversion of Saint Paul; Adam and Eve
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures and horses in a dynamic scene. The drawing features human figures in various poses, some interacting with a rearing horse at the center. The scene is animated, possibly depicting a battle or moment of chaos. Above, there are sketches suggesting celestial or divine presence with light rays and cloud-like forms. The lower part of the drawing shows figures engaged in intense interactions, with a sense of movement conveyed through sweeping lines and varied ink intensities. The composition is lively and energetic, with detailed muscular forms and dynamic poses depicted through skillful line work.

artworks.title: View of Rome with the Dome of Saint Peter's and the Castel Sant' Angelo
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with sanguine, brown, and gray wash over graphite on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Vincent and Linda Buonanno
artworks.description: The image displays a cityscape view with classical architecture. The scene includes a street, buildings, Castel Sant'Angelo, a bridge over a river, and a basilica dome in the distance. The low horizon shows rooftops and structures fading into the background. The style uses pen and ink with a light wash, creating a sepia-toned look. The color palette consists of earthy browns and soft grays. The sky is left mostly blank, adding to the sense of openness.

artworks.title: Fantasy of an Ancient Bath
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash and traces of red chalk, on laid paper pasted down on the remains of Piranesi's original mount
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior with tall columns and arches. The drawing depicts a grand architectural space featuring a series of towering columns supporting arches, with two prominent pediments visible in the scene. The intricate detailing suggests an emphasis on the classical elements of architecture. The space appears expansive, with high ceilings and large arched windows allowing light to flood into the interior. There is a play of light and shadows that accentuates the depth and volume of the architectural structures. The monochromatic palette of the drawing adds to the timeless and majestic quality of the architectural scene.

artworks.title: Studies of the Virgin and Child with Saints
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over red chalk (only in the study of the Madonna at the top) on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a collection of sketches on a single page featuring various figures in different positions. The sketches depict full-body and half-body figures in reclining or seated postures, some holding an infant or a child. The faces have minimal detail, with some featuring long hair. The figures are clothed in flowing garments without distinct jewelry. The scene around them is composed of sketch lines, suggesting movement or layers of drawn elements. The background is plain to highlight the sketches on the paper.

artworks.title: The Virgin of the Immaculate Conception
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over red chalk and graphite on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a figure of a person positioned in a kneeling pose, surrounded by multiple cherubs. The person has long, flowing hair and a serene expression. They are wearing long, flowing robes. The cherubs have curly hair and are holding a garland or wreath. Some are floating on clouds. The background is filled with clouds, creating a heavenly scene. No jewelry is visible on the main figure, but the atmospheric elements enhance the ethereal quality of the setting.

artworks.title: The Vest of August the Strong
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed garment, a jacket with decorative patterns along the edges and buttons. The colors are black, grey, and white. The jacket appears to be lying flat or draped over an object, with textured folds and shadows. Text is displayed in the upper left and lower area of the image.

artworks.title: A Royal Party Admiring the Sunset atop the Hesselberg Mountain
artworks.medium: watercolor, gouache, and pen and gray ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: The image features a lower angle perspective looking up at a rocky outcropping where elegantly dressed people are gathered. The individuals are situated on a large rock and to the right, interacting amid shrubs and trees. The horizon is obscured by the rocky terrain, but the sky above is clear with soft cloud formations. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing the texture of the rocks and foliage. The color palette includes earthy tones for the rocks and vegetation, with pops of color in the clothing of the people. In the distance, there are soft transitions between the sky and distant terrain.

artworks.title: The Apparition in the Forest
artworks.medium: pen and brush with brown and light brown ink and wash over graphite, including borderlines, on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund

artworks.title: Saint Cecilia
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image is a detailed pencil drawing of a person lying on their side. The individual is in a relaxed pose, possibly sleeping, with their body curled and arms under their head. Their face appears serene with closed eyes, a gentle expression, and medium-length curly hair. The person is wearing flowing garments, resembling historic or religious attire. They are depicted on grass with faint hills or mountains in the background. The style is classical with a subtle and delicate composition.

artworks.title: Two Grieving Angels (verso)
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in an art sketch. The figures are in a leaning position, facing each other. Both have curly hair and detailed facial features. They wear flowing garments, and there are sketches of hands, with one holding a palm branch. The background is plain, highlighting the figures' outlines.

artworks.title: Minerva and the Muses
artworks.medium: watercolor over pen and brown and gray ink and traces of graphite, heightened with white gouache, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals playing musical instruments and interacting in a classical setting. Various figures with unique hairstyles and draped garments in soft colors are seen seated and standing. Some are playing instruments like a lute and a violin, while others are gesturing or holding music sheets. The background includes lush foliage, trees, and hints of distant architecture, enhancing the classical ambiance.
